items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: He was a wonderful boss because he never told you what to do or what to play.

ctx.x: Oh, he was wonderful, he was wonderful, he just — (if I’d known we were going to do this I would have brought a blue towel, I hope this is in color.) He was a wonderful boss because he never told you what to do or what to play. I asked our road manager, band manager at that time it was Sonny Cohn, and Cup sat right in front of me on the band bus, and after I’d been with the band about maybe two weeks, you know I said, “Sonny, you know, Basie hasn’t said anything to me about whether he wants it this way, or he…
The guy didn’t play a note yet?

items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Basie had a series of signals that he would give to me. Raising the eyebrows was one.

ctx.x: Did Basie ever like raise his eyebrows and give you a look that you interpreted as, I’m not going to do that again.

No he didn’t, and that’s a good question too. Basie had a series of signals that he would give to me. Raising the eyebrows was one. Raising the eyebrows meant to increase the volume or to get ready for the explosion. That’s how — that’s how physical he would become on the bandstand. You know, we’re not talking Stan Kenton and waving the arms from wall to wall. Basie had a minimum of motion to give me direction. Sometimes when we were playing he would tilt his head. That’s where he’d want the beat, on two and…

items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: and I'm very happy with Butch.

ctx.x: I don't know, I heard him with Mel and that guy was terrific as a soloist you know, and I still think he is and the more we get along together, the longer we play I mean the tighter everything gets together, (inaudible) as far as being like a big band drummer you know, and I'm very happy with Butch.
Would you say he's got a lot of show biz in him?
